scientific_scope: finite point comparison of four response-equivalent parity-3 realizations on one CPython 3.12 hosted-Linux execution substrate; not a universal intelligence-family claim

problem.obligation: For every x in {0,1}^3, emit x0 XOR x1 XOR x2 exactly.

family_definitions.NEURAL: Feed-forward affine-threshold networks: the original four-minterm hidden layer and a separately derived three-hidden-unit shared-sum network. Both use a threshold output.
family_definitions.NON_NEURAL: Direct two-XOR Boolean program and exact eight-entry lookup table, each returning one bit.

candidates.reachability: directly constructed frozen source; no training/search
directly constructed frozen source; no training/search
direct algebraic construction using parity as alternating cumulative thresholds; no timing-guided search
direct exhaustive truth table; no timing-guided search

development_accounting.development_reachability_gate: both candidate functions must be present and pass exhaustive capability before measurement
development_accounting.reason: Continues the deployment-only point comparison with four directly constructed candidates. Construction and optimization time are excluded and no lifecycle superiority is claimed.

measurement_schedule.candidate_order: rotate base order by block modulo 4; reverse base order on odd groups of 4

registered_resource_coordinates.name: python_opcode_count_per_full_domain_sweep

registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: none for the executed interpreter/code artifact

registered_resource_coordinates.semantics: perf_counter_ns elapsed time for exactly 160000 protected candidate calls in one timed block
registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: finite observed schedule envelope [minimum block, maximum block]; no claim of population confidence beyond the registered run

registered_resource_coordinates.name: process_block_ns
registered_resource_coordinates.semantics: process_time_ns CPU time for exactly 160000 protected candidate calls in one timed block
registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: finite observed schedule envelope [minimum block, maximum block]; no claim of population confidence beyond the registered run

selection_rule.rule: Remove a candidate iff another registered candidate robustly box-dominates it. Report the complete surviving frontier. Select a family only when every frontier candidate belongs to that family; report a unique candidate winner only for a singleton frontier. Mixed-family frontier means abstention. No scalarization or post-outcome tie-break.

candidate_expansion_attack.scope: one algebraically reduced exact threshold network and one exact lookup table; no global architecture optimization or independent external optimization is claimed

claim_ceiling: Four frozen candidates on parity-3 and the executed CPython 3.12 hosted runner, using finite observed deployment envelopes. No universal family winner, all-architecture optimization, independent prospective replication, development-cost advantage or representative intelligence claim.

execution_policy.timed_execution: First main-push attempt only; no PR timing, local timing or rerun for outcome selection.
execution_policy.deterministic_self_tests: Exhaustive capability, complete opcode traces, synthetic adjudication and schedule balance may be checked before freeze without timing.
execution_policy.failure_policy: A failed expectation is valid scientific output; instrument or capability failure invalidates evidence and requires a separately registered repair.

registered_expansion_expectation.prediction: The expanded robust frontier will contain only NON_NEURAL candidates.
registered_expansion_expectation.falsifier: A surviving neural candidate makes this expectation fail. Any protocol or exact-capability failure invalidates the packet. Mixed-family frontier requires abstention.
registered_expansion_expectation.post_failure_rule: No changes to candidates, schedule, coordinates, scope or selection after timing; keep every first-run outcome, including failures and abstentions.
registered_expansion_expectation.epistemic_status: Outcome-informed hostile expansion after reading V1 and V2, frozen before V4 timing; V3 has not executed. Not independent prospective replication.
